name: ATM Command 15
definition: Result of a maintenance command performed by the ATM.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of command to be performed by the ATM.

RequiredDateTime.name: Required Date Time
RequiredDateTime.definition: Date time on which the command has been requested to be performed.

ProcessedDateTime.name: Processed Date Time
ProcessedDateTime.definition: Date time on which the command has been performed.

CommandIdentification.name: Command Identification
CommandIdentification.definition: Identification of the entity issuing the command.

Result.name: Result
Result.definition: Final result of the processed command at the ATM.

AdditionalErrorInformation.name: Additional Error Information
AdditionalErrorInformation.definition: Additional information on the failure to be logged for further examination.
